top_signals.title: Japan looks to clamp down on spread of invasive beetle species
top_signals.summary: The red-necked longhorn beetle was found for the first time in 2012 in Aichi Prefecture and can kill cherry blossom trees.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
